title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Banking & Financial Services - Paraguay

description.narrative: The advisor is assisting the Central Bank of Paraguay (CBP) with implementing a Consumer Protection Regulatory framework, including a claims, grievances, and dispute resolution. The advisor is supporting the CBP with the execution of its National Financial Inclusion Strategy, including the implementation of a regulatory framework for electronic payment systems providing mobile financial services and pre-paid cards, as well as the drafting of secured transaction reforms.
